from.place: Proof paragraphs 2--3, ordinary projective-line input: the cardinalities of the two geometric-fibre homology groups

title: Cardinalities of the two projective-line fibre homology groups
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by $N$, and $k$ an algebraically closed field in which $N$ is nonzero. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_k$ and $F=A(1)_P$, using the specified ordinary finite Tate line [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Suppose that for every proof of invertibility of $N$ on $P$, the scalar orbit of the actual scalar-extended Kummer class of $\mathcal O(1)$ is a bijection from $A$ onto $H^2(P,F)$ [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. Then for $n=0$ and $n=-2$ there is an equivalence of sets $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}k,H^n(Rp_*(F[2])))\simeq A$, where $p:P\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is projection and sections are given by the inverse constant-sheaf equivalence [def-sp-ordinary-finite-fibre-homology-comparison]. Thus either group has cardinality $|A|$.

source.place: Geometric-fibre Kummer-class calculation and finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Use the explicit homology/global-cohomology comparison. For n=0 this identifies sections with H2 of the single Tate-line module. The adopted nonempty_cohomology_singleFunctor_iso_sheafH comparison identifies its additive group with Sheaf.H. The assumed scalar generator bijection gives an equivalence with A. For n=-2 the comparison gives H0. Trivialize the Tate line using a primitive root, as in the Tate-coefficient helper. The geometric projective line is connected by the genus-zero theorem; its constant H0 is therefore A by constantComplexIsoSingleFunctorConstantSheaf and cohomologyZeroConstantComplexIso in the adopted KummerAffineLine API. Compose these actual equivalences. Properness supplies compactness and quasi-separatedness for the H2 comparison. The zero ring gives singleton groups and needs no exception.

theorem ordinaryFiniteP1_fibre_target_card
    (N : ℕ) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (hNk : (N : k) ≠ 0)
    (hκ : ∀ (hP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)), ⊤))),
      Function.Bijective (fun a : A ↦ Sheaf.H.map
        ((moduleAbelianForget A (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)))).map
          (a • 𝟙 (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))) N A hA))) 2
        (ordinaryFiniteP1KummerClass A N hA (Spec (.of k)) hP)))
    (n : ℤ) (hn : n = 0 ∨ n = -2) :
    Nonempty (
      ((constantSheafEquivalenceOfIsSepClosed A (k := k)).inverse.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
          ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A
            (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)) ↘ Spec (.of k))).obj
              ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA
                (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)))) ≃ A)
